audience: field teams and offices that collect form submissions in Kizeo Forms

useCases.title: Find a form and its fields
useCases.text: List the forms of the account, then read one form's definition with its fields and field types.

useCases.title: Search submitted data
useCases.text: Search the data records of one form, or of all forms, with advanced filters and ordering. Read one record with its field values.

useCases.title: Work through unread submissions
useCases.text: Read the unread records for one action, up to a limit. Then mark the records you handled as read for that action.

useCases.title: Read users, groups and external lists
useCases.text: List the users and groups of the account. List the external lists, and read one list with its items.
